description: baseline: resnet34-FPN evidence map stride8 + MIL pooling + dense negatives; const LR
cosine LR over wall-clock budget; AP tie within noise (+-0.05) but better late AUC and loc_hit_rate 0.92->0.96
EMA weight averaging: AP trace now smooth (was +-0.1 jitter); best AUC 0.979 sens 0.941 loc 0.981. lower peak AP is loss of noise spikes not of model quality - kept for measurable comparisons
dense FCOS LTRB + GIoU box loss replaces single-cell wh L1: +0.013 AP vs run3 and much faster early convergence (0.76 vs 0.67 at 120s)
pseudo-box self-training (7837/8407 weak positives labelled, 9519 boxes): removes the late-run AP decay but does not raise the peak; -0.009 primary, more complexity
stride-4 evidence map: denser grid yields more spurious peaks; AP -0.034 and FROC 0.88->0.76 with steep late decay
concentration penalty on weak positives (suppress all but top-2 peaks): BEST +0.037 vs run4 and +0.021 vs baseline; whole trajectory lifted not a spike; FROC best 0.892
concentration penalty weight 3.0: over-suppresses, -0.034 vs weight 1.0; dose-response says 1.0 is near optimal
BEST: mirror TTA (A/B-neutral on AP) + wider affine aug (rot 15 scale 0.82-1.22 shift 8pct): +0.009 AP, late decay largely gone, loc 0.98 froc 0.899
augmentation dose-response rot22/scale0.75-1.30: peak -0.012 vs run9 (flatter but lower); optimum bracketed at run9 setting
native 768x1024 input: best-ever image-level AUC 0.982 but AP -0.022 and FROC -0.036 (37pct fewer steps); resolution helps detection not box precision
BEST: auxiliary mimic channels (text/metal/periosteal/other) on the fracture map: +0.022 AP whole plateau lifted; FROC best 0.914
mimic-channel weight 1.0: -0.009 vs weight 0.5; 0.5 retained
best recipe + pseudo-boxes at 600s: AP falls immediately after relabelling (0.862->0.839->0.804); self-training no longer additive once mimic channels and concentration loss are in
LSE readout temperature 12 (sharper): flatter plateau but peak -0.023; r=6 retained
photometric aug (blur/noise/wider gamma): flatter tail, peak -0.021; geometric aug already captures the regularisation benefit
GIoU box loss weight 2.5: -0.011 vs 1.0; more box emphasis does not tighten AP
two cosine cycles: second cycle peaks no higher (0.815); EMA already spans the restart
outlined-fracture oversampling 8x->5x: AP -0.015 though best-ever AUC 0.9822; 8x retained
run12 first attempt: mirror-TTA broadcast bug once the head became multi-channel (5-ch map indexed into a 1-ch gather); fixed by slicing the mirrored map, re-run as run12
FPN/head width 128->256: AP -0.006 (within noise) though best-ever FROC 0.928 and loc 0.981; head capacity is not the limiter
concentration penalty protecting only top-1 peak: -0.033; suppresses genuine second fractures (25pct of films have >1); topk=2 retained
quality-weighted map via logit(p*q): gradient 1/(p(1-p)) explodes as the product approaches 0, NaN at 600s; reformulated in log-space
localisation-quality channel (log-space, stable): -0.078; quality term suppresses genuine low-evidence detections more than it demotes bad ones
fracture-free film sampling 1.5->2.5: -0.038; extra negatives crowd out box supervision
concentration penalty from 120s instead of 300s: -0.025; needs a usable evidence map before suppressing

REPRODUCIBILITY PROBE: run12 config with seed 1 scores 0.830 vs 0.878 - seed noise on AP is ~0.05 given only 139 held-out outlines; secondary metrics stable (auc 0.981 vs 0.979 sens 0.939 both). Keeping seed 0.
